post.summary: Inventory the columns of Reconciliation Datasets
post.description: Returns each listed Dataset's columns plus the cross-side auto-matches for a Reconciliation's unified column list; body datasets is the list of Dataset ids. No capability gate. 422 when datasets is missing, a Dataset config is unusable or the inventory query fails; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only or the query sandbox cannot be opened.

post.summary: One day of the Board: a page of grain rows + the day's exact totals and Break summary
post.description: Stateless compute over a saved reconciliation (`id`) or an inline draft (`config`), scoped to ONE day (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09). The day's comparison is computed once (one grain join; totals, pair summaries and the group count from one aggregate over it) and cached in memory per (spec, day, sample, input-file stamps), so a further page or filter of the same day is a cache read (`statistics.cached`). `totals` and `summary` cover the whole day whatever the page or filter.

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

filter.description: Which grain rows the page lists; missing_c only on a 3-way reconciliation.

sample.description: Compare at most this many keys, chosen deterministically (hash of the key); reported in `sample`.

availableDays.description: Days present across the sides, newest first, at most 366.

post.summary: The paged Break sets of one anchor-relative pair
post.description: Stateless compute over a saved reconciliation (`id`) or an inline draft (`config`). Rows always carry the anchor as role `a` and the compared side (`side`: b|c) as role `b`. When the config declares `impact.column` naming a column that is NOT compared, each Break row also carries that column's per-side value as `impact` — summed per key, never compared, so it cannot create or suppress a Break (operator decision 2026-09-25).

config.description: An inline reconciliation config (datasets, keyColumns, compareColumns, impact:{column, currency}, ...).

path.description: Board dimension path: key column -> value.

sample.description: Compare only this many keys - the same deterministic keys POST /recon/run samples; the answer then carries a `sample` block {sampled, size, keys, totalKeys} (RECON-PERF-RESIDUALS-1).

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

200.description: One ReconBreakSet per Break type (all of them unless `type` narrows it).

post.summary: Promote a Reconciliation Break to an Incident
post.description: Opens one Incident for a single Break of a saved Reconciliation (body reconciliation, key, optional type, column, runId), deduped on the Break's (type, key, column) identity; returns incidentId and deduped. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 when reconciliation or key is missing; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation; 503 when the control plane is read-only or operational objects are not installed.

get.summary: Breaks of a Reconciliation that have an active Incident
get.description: Maps each Break identity of the Reconciliation named by query reconciliation to its active (non-terminal) Incident id, capped at 1000 entries with the true total and a truncated flag. No capability gate. 422 when reconciliation is missing or not a safe name; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation; 503 when operational objects are not installed.

post.summary: Raw rows behind one Reconciliation key
post.description: Returns the raw rows on both compared sides for one key of a saved Reconciliation (id) or an inline config; body key must name every key column, with optional side (b or c), day and limit. No capability gate. 422 when key is missing, side is not b|c or the config or comparison fails; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation or Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only or the query sandbox cannot be opened.

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

get.description: Lists one row per saved Reconciliation with lastRunAt and runs (never-run ones included), capped at 1000 with the true total and a truncated flag; empty when no write root is set. No capability gate. 403 when a state file escapes its jail; 503 when a recorded state cannot be read.

Returns the Reconciliation's recorded lastRunAt, runs and Breaks, each with occurrences, recurrences, lastSeenAt, assignee and the read-time ageDays. No capability gate. 422 for an unsafe id; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation; 403 when the state path escapes its jail; 503 when the state cannot be read.

post.summary: Record a run of a Reconciliation
post.description: Computes every Break of the saved Reconciliation server-side (optional body day), merges them into its recorded state and stamps lastRunAt; returns the new state. Gated on canOperateRuns. 422 for an unsafe id, an unusable config, a failing comparison or more Breaks than the state may hold; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation or Dataset; 403 on a jail escape; 503 when the control plane is read-only or the sandbox or state is unavailable. Records ONE day (`day`, else the latest present) and answers the state plus the recorded `day` (RECON-PERF-1).

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

post.summary: Resolve, re-open or assign a Reconciliation Break
post.description: Sets one Break's status by identity (body type, key, status resolved|open|assigned, optional pair AB|AC, column, day, note, and assignee only with assigned); returns the reconciliation and the updated break. Gated on canOperateRuns. 422 for an unsafe id, invalid field, AC on a two-way Reconciliation or a full state; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation; 403 on a jail escape; 503 when the control plane is read-only or the state is unreadable.

day.description: The day the Break is of (per-day lifecycle, operator 2026-10-09); absent = an undated Break recorded before it.
